mapper.select: select p.ZZQKXXBS, p.DZZDM, p.DZZMC,fb.ZZLB, fb.JCZZFL, p.JLDZZRQ, p.SCYTDZB, p.KZPYRQ, p.JSPYRQ, p.YL01, p.YL02, p.YL03, p.YL04, p.YL05,z.HZMC as ZZLBMC,j.HZMC as JCZZFLMC, p.DZZDM NODECODE,SUBSTR(p.DZZDM,1,LENGTH(p.DZZDM)-3) PARENTCODE from ZZ_ZZQKXX p left join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on p.DZZDM=fb.DZZDM left join zzzd_zzlbdmnew z on fb.ZZLB = z.BM left join zzzd_jczzflnew j on fb.JCZZFL = j.BM where 1=1 and p.DZZDM = #{dzzdm} order by PARENTCODE,NODECODE

select 2 as "nodetype", p.DZZDM as "id", SUBSTR(p.DZZDM,1,LENGTH(p.DZZDM)-3) as "parentId", p.DZZMC as "name", count(c.DZZDM) as "partyCount",-- 下级组织个数 fbType.SORT, 0 as "isexpand" from ZZ_ZZQKXX p left join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on p.DZZDM=fb.DZZDM left join ( select c.* from ZZ_ZZQKXX c left join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB cfb on c.DZZDM= cfb.DZZDM where 1=1
and cfb.ZZLB in('100','200') -- 党委
and cfb.ZZLB in('100','200') and LENGTH(c.DZZDM)=12 -- 一级党委
and cfb.ZZLB not in('500')
) c on p.dzzdm=SUBSTR(c.DZZDM,1,LENGTH(c.DZZDM)-3) left join ZZ_DZZFBQK fbType on p.DZZDM = fbType.DZZDM where 1=1 and p.DZZDM like concat('',#{parentCode},'%') and length(p.DZZDM)=(length(#{parentCode})+3)
and p.DZZDM = #{dzzdm}
and fb.ZZLB not in('500')
and fb.ZZLB in('100','200') -- 党委
group by p.DZZDM,p.DZZMC,p.ZZLB,fbType.SORT order by p.ZZLB, SUBSTR(p.DZZDM,1,LENGTH(p.DZZDM)-3),p.DZZDM

select distinct y.DZZDM,y.DZZMC,uz.DZZMC SZDZBMC,y.RYBM,u.XM,y.ZLYTYPE,jszw.HZMC as JSZWMC, dnzw.DNZW, dnzw.PZRZRQ as PZRZRQ,u.ZWMC from ZZ_DZZZLY y inner join VM_RYJBXX u on y.RYBM=u.RYBM left join zd_zyjszwdm jszw on u.xjszwmc=jszw.bm -- 技术专业职务 left join vw_partyduty dnzw on u.rybm=dnzw.rybm -- 党内职务名称 inner join ZZ_ZZQKXX uz on u.SZDZBDM= uz.dzzdm where y.DZZDM=#{dzzdm}

select p.ZZQKXXBS, p.DZZDM, p.DZZMC,fb.ZZLB, fb.JCZZFL, p.JLDZZRQ, p.SCYTDZB, p.KZPYRQ, p.JSPYRQ, ifnull(fb.DYZS,0) as DYZS,ifnull(fb.ZGRS,0) as ZGRS, z.HZMC as ZZLBMC,j.HZMC as JCZZFLMC,fb.LDJTJC,bz.LDJTDXRQ as SCHJSJ,bz.GJJMRQ as DQHJSJ, (select count(*) from ZZ_ZZQKXX c inner join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on c.DZZDM=fb.DZZDM where p.DZZDM=SUBSTR(c.DZZDM,1,length(p.DZZDM)) and p.DZZDM!=c.DZZDM and fb.ZZLB !='500') as childCount from ZZ_ZZQKXX p left join ZZ_ZZQKXXFB fb on p.DZZDM=fb.DZZDM left join zzzd_zzlbdmnew z on fb.ZZLB = z.BM left join zzzd_jczzflnew j on fb.JCZZFL = j.BM left join ZZ_BZJCXX bz on p.DZZDM = bz.DZZDM and bz.LDJTJC = fb.LDJTJC where 1=1 and p.DZZDM =#{dzzdm}
